description: This file defines structures, constants, enums, and functions related to GTP-U protocol data units (PDUs), including header parsing, extension headers, information elements, and message handling, following 3GPP TS 29.281 specifications.

classes.name: gtpu_extension_header
classes.description: Base class for GTP-U extension headers containing type and container data.

classes.name: gtpu_ie_recovery
classes.description: Information element for GTP-U recovery, containing a restart counter.

classes.name: gtpu_ie_teid_i
classes.description: Information element for Tunnel Endpoint Identifier Data I.

classes.name: gtpu_ie_gtpu_peer_address
classes.description: Information element for GTP-U peer address, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

classes.name: gtpu_ie_private_extension
classes.description: Information element for private extensions with an identifier and value.

classes.name: gtpu_header
classes.description: Represents the GTP-U header including flags, message type, length, TEID, sequence number, N-PDU, and extension list.

classes.name: gtpu_dissected_pdu
classes.description: Represents a dissected GTP-U PDU with access to header and raw content.

classes.name: gtpu_msg_error_indication
classes.description: Structure for GTP-U Error Indication message containing TEID and peer address.

methods.name: gtpu_read_teid
methods.description: Reads and unpacks TEID from a GTP-U PDU.

methods.name: gtpu_dissect_pdu
methods.description: Dissects a raw GTP-U PDU into header and extension content.

methods.name: gtpu_write_header
methods.description: Prepares and writes a GTP-U header into a PDU buffer.

methods.name: gtpu_write_ie_recovery
methods.description: Appends a recovery information element to a GTP-U PDU.

methods.name: gtpu_write_ie_private_extension
methods.description: Appends a private extension information element.

methods.name: gtpu_write_ie_gtpu_peer_address
methods.description: Appends GTP-U peer address information element.

methods.name: gtpu_supported_flags_check
methods.description: Checks if GTP-U flags are supported.

methods.name: gtpu_supported_msg_type_check
methods.description: Checks if GTP-U message type is supported.

methods.name: gtpu_extension_header_comprehension_check
methods.description: Checks if extension header type comprehension is supported.

methods.name: gtpu_extract_msg
methods.description: Extracts the message payload from a dissected GTP-U PDU.

methods.name: gtpu_read_msg_error_indication
methods.description: Reads and unpacks a GTP-U Error Indication message.
